evaluation.benchmark: MOT17 pedestrian with distractor/zero-mark preprocessing, CLEAR IoU .5, Identity and HOTA
evaluation.coordinates: uniform integer video-to-original-GT scale verified per sequence, then x/y shifted +1 for one-based MOT output
evaluation.scenario_diagnostics: Separate full-frame Hungarian IoU .5 endpoint/instance diagnostics; not official scenario MOT metrics

scenario_rules.long_low_visibility: visibility <=.3 for >=1s, >=.6 visibility anchors within 1s before and after
scenario_rules.overlap_order_exchange: GT box IoU >=.1, overlap index gaps merged <=ceil(.5*fps) frame steps, horizontal center order flips across >=.6 visibility anchors within 1s
scenario_rules.endpoints: last matched pre / first matched post eligible anchor; denominator reports missing endpoints separately

evaluation.timing: Three fresh tracker runs by default; rotated method order, first update included, no warmup exclusion. Detector/decode/startup excluded from update latency. Descriptive single-host timing, not real-time acceptance.
evaluation.birth_control: Only veto unmatched high-confidence births after upstream association; IoU >= .5 against confirmed retained track states after CMC/update. No input filtering or changes to weak association.

limitations: Selected compressed training clips, not original benchmark JPEGs or a held-out leaderboard result.
Visibility/order proxies do not establish physical occlusion or true 3D crossing; audit examples separately.

Exploratory confirmation/birth-competition ablation on previously studied training scenes, not an independent acceptance group. No ReID, CMC ablation, worker IPC or default change. BoT-SORT successful-update counter and instant-first-frame exception remain upstream behaviour.
No real-camera, calibrated 3D, Windows, endurance or end-to-end throughput acceptance.
public_scope: Aggregates, source/configuration identifiers and hashes only. Media, GT, event identities/windows, per-frame predictions, weights and paths stay local.

failed_conditions: No combined FP or IDSW decrease

decision.summary: Longer confirmation trades fewer FP for more FN and lower combined IDF1/HOTA. Birth IoU .5 veto never triggered; exact predictions equal reference. No threshold retuning after results. Independent acceptance and general long-occlusion recovery remain open.
